kevin: We should finalize the chunk manifest schema. I hacked a minimal example. thoughts?
sasha: paste it here pls.
kevin: ```json
{
  "artifact": "model-v2.1.0",
  "version": 2,
  "chunks": [
    {"id": 1, "sha256": "abcd...", "size": 1048576},
    {"id": 2, "sha256": "ef01...", "size": 1048576}
  ],
  "trusted_keys": [
    {"id": "k1", "alg": "ed25519", "sig": "base64..."}
  ],
  "retire_mode": "none",
  "hold_window_secs": 60
}
```
sasha: looks good. couple notes: add chunk compression hint and optional diff parent id.
olivia: add schema for bloom index URL and optional index_version.
deploy-bot: lint: schema passes basic validation.
kevin: updated draft: include `compression: zstd`, `diff_parent: null`, `bloom_index: {url: "...", version: 1}`.
sasha: perfect. I'll fold into RFC and add state machine sample.
kevin: also mention manifest size limits and suggested chunk size defaults (4MB-64MB) depending on network.
kevin: deploy-bot: run integration tests for manifest parsing.
deploy-bot: queued job "manifest-parse-int" (runtime est 12m).
kevin: thanks, will follow CI results.
